newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Light raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Light raised to buy.

text.p: ING Barings said it raised Rio de Janeiro power distributor Light to a buy from a hold based on expected earnings growth and valuation relative to the sector.

-- Charles Barnett, head of Latin American electric utilities research at ING, said in his report that Light was expected to emerge as a major player in future Brazil and regional power privatizations. He added that Light gives investors a low-risk hedge against potential privatization delays.
-- Barnett raised earnings per share estimates for Light to $31.33 from $19.95 per 1,000 shares in 1997 and to $38.56 from $24.33 per 1,000 shares in 1998.
-- Light fell 15 reais to 555 on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange.
